name: Scattering Shout
text:
With a flex of your mighty thews and a guttural bellow that can make ears bleed, you drive back any enemies surrounding you. Each enemy within a 10-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude save saving throw against your class DC.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Failure The creature is pushed 10 feet away from you and takes 8d6 sonic damage.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 15 feet away from you and takes 16d6 sonic damage.
